name: Des Moines
seo_title: 4 Christmas Events for Kids in Des Moines, WA 2026
seo_desc: 4 Christmas events for kids in Des Moines, WA, 1 free: Winter Waterland Tree Lighting at the Des Moines Marina and more.
lede: Des Moines celebrates Christmas on the water: the city's tree lighting has moved to the Des Moines Marina, Santa comes in by boat, and the Argosy Christmas Ship stops to sing at the marina pier.
celebrates: The City of Des Moines builds its holiday season around the waterfront. Its Winter Waterland Tree Lighting takes place at the Des Moines Marina, with a holiday gift market, performers, professional Santa photos and Santa arriving by boat. The Des Moines Activity Center hosts Breakfast with Santa with crafts, breakfast and photos. Each December the Argosy Christmas Ship Festival sails from the marina with a choir aboard and sings carols to families on the pier. The city's recreation staff also schedule smaller holiday programs such as cookie decorating and a karaoke sing along, listed in the City Manager Report.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Des Moines held its annual Holiday Tree Lighting at the Des Moines Marina on Saturday, December 6, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm, and promoted the marina celebration to families on its own Facebook page. That same day, Sound Transit opened Kent Des Moines Station on the Link 1 Line, giving the city its first light rail stop near Highline College.
facts: Des Moines, Washington, is named after Des Moines, Iowa. In 1889 F. A. Blasher, who had moved west from Des Moines, Iowa, sold his land to John W. Kleeb and Orin Watts Barlow, who platted the townsite and gave it his hometown's name. Early commuters rode the Mosquito Fleet steamers on Puget Sound. Residents voted to incorporate in 1959 instead of becoming part of Kent, and the city has long called itself the Waterland City, with a summer Waterland Festival that began in 1960.
trains: Light rail reached Des Moines on December 6, 2025, when Sound Transit opened Kent Des Moines Station, an elevated stop just southwest of I 5 at the SR 516 exit that serves Highline College. From there the Link 1 Line runs north to Sea Tac Airport and Seattle and south to Federal Way. A century ago, the Seattle Tacoma Interurban ran through the valley five miles east of town. Nearby Burien is home to the Pacific Northwest Railroad Archive, and the Northwest Railway Museum in Snoqualmie runs a Santa Train.
train_links: Maps, ledgers, timetables and photos of Northwest railroads in nearby Burien.
Historic trains in Snoqualmie, including the Santa Train each December.

traditions: The city lights its holiday tree at the Des Moines Marina, where Santa arrives by boat.
The Argosy Christmas Ship Festival, a Puget Sound tradition since 1949, sails from Des Moines and sings to families on the marina pier.
The Des Moines Activity Center serves breakfast with crafts and Santa photos in two morning seatings.
City recreation staff host a cookie decorating and crafts program in late December, listed in the City Manager Report.
kidfact: Des Moines, Washington, borrowed its name from Des Moines, Iowa. A man who moved here from Iowa sold the land for the new town, and it was named after his old home.
faq: Where is the Des Moines tree lighting?

The City of Des Moines holds its Winter Waterland Tree Lighting at the Des Moines Marina, 22307 Dock Avenue South. The city's Winter Waterland flyer lists a holiday gift market, performers and entertainers, professional Santa photos and Santa arriving by boat at the marina.
Does the Christmas Ship stop in Des Moines?

Yes. The Argosy Christmas Ship Festival includes a Des Moines departure from the marina. The choir sings to families on the Des Moines Marina Pier and, on the late sailing, at the Redondo Beach fishing pier. Seattle Southside, the area's official tourism site, lists watching from shore as free.
Is there Breakfast with Santa in Des Moines, WA?

Yes. The City of Des Moines holds Breakfast with Santa at the Des Moines Activity Center, 2045 South 216th Street, with breakfast, holiday crafts, photos with Santa and time to share wish lists. Tickets are sold per person through the city's DaySmart registration site, and every child must come with an adult who also has a ticket.
Why is Des Moines, Washington named after Iowa?

In 1889 F. A. Blasher, who had moved west from Des Moines, Iowa, sold his land to John W. Kleeb and Orin Watts Barlow. They platted the townsite, named it Des Moines and formed the Des Moines City Improvement Company. The town grew on Puget Sound and incorporated as a city in 1959.
Which light rail station is closest to Des Moines?

Kent Des Moines Station on the Link 1 Line, which opened on December 6, 2025. It sits just southwest of I 5 at the SR 516 exit, serves Highline College and has a parking garage with about 500 spaces. Trains run north to Sea Tac Airport and Seattle and south to Federal Way.

Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Des Moines for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Winter Waterland Tree Lighting at the Des Moines Marina) through December 16, with Winter Waterland Tree Lighting at the Des Moines Marina (December 4), Breakfast with Santa at the Des Moines Activity Center (December 12) and Argosy Christmas Ship Festival at Des Moines Marina (December 16) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.
